hypothesis: Choosing scope per book from development evidence lands macro CER near the 0.355552 per-page oracle, identifying which AncientDoc volumes annotate commentary into gold; and character-grain agreement within paired columns restores at least 0.80 recall of healthy-page gold while holding at least 0.96 precision.
decision: Adopt per-book scope flags as the AncientDoc evaluation policy for any future suite: selection from two development pages per book scores 0.358035 macro, within 0.002483 of the per-page oracle, and cleanly partitions the corpus into nine primary-scope and five full-scope volumes, converting the gold-scope confound into recorded metadata. Adopt character-grain consensus within the column pairing as the verification signal: it recovers 91.07 percent recall of healthy-page gold at 0.946730 micro and 0.964114 macro precision against 37.75 percent recall at the column-exact point, giving the verification architecture a measured two-point precision-coverage frontier. The remaining precision drag on healthy pages concentrates in one dense worn-print page where both channels agree on the same misreadings, which no agreement rule can detect and only a third independent channel or human sample can catch.

books_choosing_primary: 武經七書講義全彙合参
scope_selection_results.transfer_limitation: Qualification-reserve books are disjoint, so these flags do not transfer; reserve books need their own derivation or versioned gold correction before qualification use.

consensus_grain_results.frontier_reading: Column-exact agreement trades 53 recall points for 2.2 precision points over character grain. Both operating points sit far above the 0.62-0.75 accuracy of any single channel.
consensus_grain_results.residual: The healthy-page precision floor is 0.853916 on the dense 藝文類聚 spread where both channels repeat identical misreadings of small worn print; same-error agreement is invisible to any two-channel rule.

gate_status.consensus_recovery: partial: recall 0.910709 passes 0.80; precision 0.964114 macro passes 0.96 while 0.946730 micro falls short
gate_status.immutability: pass: every consumed artifact hash matches the preflight; no prior artifact modified

evidence.inputs: as fingerprinted in the preflight record
evidence.scorer: rapidfuzz 3.14.3 Levenshtein distance and opcodes, installed for scoring and removed afterward

limitations: Development evidence on 28 cases and 14 books, two pages per book; scope flags are development-derived metadata, not model improvements.
Character-grain consensus inherits the pairing's line-column alignment; alignment mistakes surface as reduced coverage, not as false agreement.
Same-error agreement remains unmeasurable from two channels alone.
next_permitted_action: The next paid experiment is the redesigned disagreement pass: show the full page with each disputed span highlighted in context and adjudicate only non-consensus residue, targeting the 5-9 percent of healthy-page characters outside consensus. Scope-flag metadata and any gold change for reserve books follow the gold-correction protocol with a new version.
